propositions: Pass-1 finders flag plan-vs-code discrepancies during execution-phase re-review that are actually expected results of the plan's directed work already being completed, blocking correct tickets from closing

A new na-default binary sub-answer `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal` must be added to the plan-review verification model to enable Pass-2 veto logic that drops such false positives only when `execution_review=True` and the answer is definite `yes`

The on-target veto must be cohort-restricted to `registry.CODEBASE_GROUNDED` (E4/G1G2/A1/G6) and enforced deterministically in the orchestrator to prevent tool-less single-turn verifiers from firing it

The `execution_review` flag must flow as a keyword-only parameter from orchestrator into the kernel's `pass3_decide` and `pass3_over_findings`, defaulting False so planning reviews and code-review calls remain unchanged
